scope: One Garage entry and a shared Upgrade visual language for Home, Career, Garage, Quick Race, Profile, Settings, dialogs and race results.
authoring: Tools / Formula Career / Unify Garage UX and Upgrade Style

navigation.garageMemory: lastGarageTab, additive optional profile field; old saves default to Upgrade and invalid values are clamped
navigation.controller: LB/RB switches Garage tabs; D-pad navigates components and levels; confirm and Back remain consistent
navigation.briefing: Garage preserves the event, mode and source-card focus; Back reopens the same briefing with refreshed vehicle rules
navigation.stockEvents: Garage identifies stock/time-trial restrictions before the player makes car changes

preview.upgrade: Focus previews a level; an explicit confirmed purchase spends credits. Owned levels equip for free.
preview.setup: Focus previews current versus proposed downforce and drag without changing physics or saving. Confirm applies a free preset.
preview.liveries: Focus previews the livery. Equip or confirmed Buy and equip changes the saved appearance. Development is retained.

presentation.art: Existing per-layer Figma Upgrade / Career logo, wallet, matte coin, footer glow and shade exports
presentation.surfaces: Native FormulaPanelGraphic gradient, hairlines and red selection, derived from the Upgrade screen; no runtime bitmap generation
presentation.type: Existing Teko and Rajdhani font assets
presentation.hierarchy: Existing view ownership retained. New surfaces and controls are serialized; results are an authored prefab with FormulaResultsView.

validation.platform: Unity Editor at 1280x720, keyboard and virtual gamepad; no target-platform build
validation.raceMethod: Temporary save, real circuit scene, scripted finish; no driving validation
